extDesc.message: Displays a reading line at your cursor so it is easier to keep your place and avoid skipping lines.

onboardingTitle.message: No reading line is shown on first open

onboardingBody.message: The empty state is expected. Keep the page you want to read open, then start from this panel.

onboardingStepPage.message: Open this popup from the tab where you want to use the reading line.

onboardingStepOn.message: You can adjust settings later, so select On below to start.

onboardingTip.message: Quick guide: once shown, the line follows your mouse and can move step by step with Shift+Alt+Up/Down.

presetKeyboardHelp.message: Use the arrow, Home, and End keys to select a preset color.

labelAutoOn.message: Turn on automatically on this site

trialRemainingOne.message: $DAYS$ day left in your free trial

trialRemainingMany.message: $DAYS$ days left in your free trial

statusFirstUseEmpty.message: This first-open empty state is expected. Select On on the page you want to read to show the line.

statusLineShown.message: Reading line shown. Use Shift+Alt+Up/Down to move it with the keyboard.

statusUnavailable.message: The reading line is not available on this page.
